name: OpenMausBot
description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use
one_liner: A chat app where each contact is really an AI worker with its own computer, apps, and personality, so you message them like coworkers and they go do the task.
buyer: A small business owner or solo operator who wants a team of task-doing AI assistants without paying for several closed AI-vendor subscriptions.
business_use_cases: An e-commerce seller runs one bot to monitor supplier emails and another to draft customer replies, treating them like two part-time hires in one app.
A marketing freelancer keeps a 'research bot' and a 'content bot' in separate chats with separate logins and files, so client work stays cleanly siloed.
A small dev shop self-hosts it to give every employee a company-branded AI assistant without routing data through a closed third-party vendor.

money_ideas.idea: Hosted/managed version with provisioned cloud computers per bot, billed per seat.
Pre-built bot personas (bookkeeper, support, social-media) sold as ready-to-install templates.

steal_this: Package three or four ready-made bot personas (inbox triage, invoice chasing, social replies) as a weekend 'starter pack' and sell the setup to small business owners.
